text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun was able to achieve
splendid results in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And Maya and Trainer
lived happily and lovey-dovey ever after~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And they lived happily ever after♪
choice_data_list: And they lived happily ever after...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, yeah. Both of you,
come back down to reality together, okay~?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! Hishiama-san,
you're being so cold!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Calling her cold is one thing, but... *sigh*"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's a pain if you keep her waiting.
So you guys better hurry up and come along too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out first!
Make sure you're not late!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I mean, like, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Geez, it really feels like everyone loves us so much.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, well, can't be helped!
Guess I'll go for everyone's sake☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~, sorry to keep you waiting☆

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...As if I'd ever wait for you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!? You were the one who asked to run together
"after school" in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Geez! Maya's mad now! I'm gonna totally beat Brian-san up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oho...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufun!
Nothing is impossible for Maya!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-chan, what's your order?!
Maya can handle anything for you!
choice_data_list: Go shine with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Eye copy☆
Nihihi, I'm gonna blast right ahead!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya-chin, taaaakeooooooff!!
